name: Mobile-Ion Defect Connectivity
definition: Graph score combining mobile-site occupancy-vacancy balance, connected-component coverage, and local pathway coordination.

name: Soft-Anion Framework
definition: Composition-weighted anion polarizability combined with framework bond weakness, compliance, and connectivity.

name: Accessible Free-Volume Connectivity
definition: Sphere-based free-volume estimate combined with local cage clearance and bottleneck accessibility along mobile-ion paths.

name: Mobile-Ion Dynamic Delocalization
definition: Occupancy disorder, split-site proximity, local-environment similarity, short-hop quality, and mobile-network coverage.

name: Mobile-Ion Hop-Network Quality
definition: Mobile-ion graph score based on hop distance, bottleneck clearance, occupancy, network regularity, vacancy, and repulsion.

name: Bottleneck-to-Mobile-Ion Radius Ratio
definition: Mean limiting pathway clearance normalized by mobile-ion radius and weighted by bottleneck uniformity and site connectivity.

name: Symmetric Mobile-Ion Pathways
definition: Weighted measure of crystal symmetry, equivalent mobile sites, lattice regularity, hop uniformity, and local bottleneck symmetry.

name: Periodic Mobile-Ion Network Dimensionality
definition: Periodic mobile-site graph evaluated by translation-cycle rank, component coverage, pathway isotropy, and route redundancy.

name: Mobile-Site Shallowness
definition: Local binding-weakness proxy combining coordination, radial and electrostatic interactions, distortion, flexibility, and vacancy.

name: Mobile-Ion Network Uniformity
definition: Connected-network coverage combined with uniformity of hop distances, coordination, local environments, and graph degree.

name: Migration-Bottleneck Radius Matching
definition: Agreement between sampled pathway clearance and mobile-ion radius, including bottleneck-shape and long-hop penalties.

name: Ion-Transport Network Quality
definition: Composite graph measure of component coverage, periodic dimensionality, hop regularity, accessibility, and environment similarity.

name: Percolating Mobile-Ion Free Volume
definition: Voxelized free-volume connectivity and periodic winding retained across multiple mobile-ion-radius accessibility thresholds.

name: Anion Softness and Weak Coordination
definition: Nearest-anion-shell score based on polarizability, radius, electronegativity, separation, and mobile-ion coordination.

name: Mobile-Ion Pathway Uniformity
definition: Uniformity of mobile-site coordination, bond distances, angular environments, interaction strengths, and pathway degrees.

name: Three-Dimensional Mobile-Ion Void Network
definition: Periodic network formed by occupied mobile sites and accessible interstitial grid points, scored by dimensionality and coverage.

name: Partial-Occupancy Mobile-Ion Network
definition: Carrier density, partial-site vacancy balance, occupancy uniformity, and nearest-site connectivity for mobile species.

name: Three-Dimensional Mobile-Ion Topology
definition: Adaptive same-species periodic graph scored by translation-cycle rank, component coverage, and local route multiplicity.

name: Mobile-Ion Sublattice Disorder
definition: Occupancy disorder weighted by connectivity between mobile sites with similar coordination and electronegativity environments.

name: Bond-Valence Percolation
definition: Mobile-site bond-valence mismatch and energy smoothness combined with periodic graph connectivity and dimensionality.

name: Mobile-Ion Vacancy Connectivity
definition: Carrier-vacancy balance and density combined with the coverage and activity of the connected mobile-site network.

name: Mobile-Ion Displacement Pathway
definition: Geometric pathway score combining hop distance, bottleneck clearance, cage openness, directionality, and network coverage.

name: Open, Flexible Percolation Network
definition: Framework openness, coherence, and bond-length flexibility combined with mobile-path dimensionality and bottleneck clearance.

name: Mobile-Ion Pathway Connectivity
definition: Clearance-filtered periodic graph scored by dimensionality, occupancy coverage, pathway width, uniformity, and dead ends.

name: Crystallographic Disorder
definition: Occupancy-based global and mobile-site disorder combined with site deficiency, split-site proximity, and disorder connectivity.
